verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a corporate banking/expense SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows CRUD deletes of configuration objects (categories, cost centers, users). It documents no retention policies, data-deletion requests, or control over how long transaction or personal data is kept. Those deletes are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
